behaviors.description: Select an unavailable subset and restore the ordinary remote catalogue.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app/runtime remote with no subset of the chosen name.
behaviors.expected: The subset property persists, unresolved subset installation cannot fall back, and clearing the subset permits exact app/runtime installation.

behaviors.description: Persist changed remote collection IDs and install from the correctly bound signed collection.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed collection source and public key.
behaviors.expected: Two distinct collection IDs remain publicly queryable; the final correct ID permits exact verified app/runtime commits.

behaviors.description: Explicitly refresh independently published remote title and comment metadata.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent public OSTree summaries with distinct A/B title and comment values.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary modify retains A; update-metadata replaces it with exact B values without deploying refs.

behaviors.description: Persist a remote opt-out before a new redirect is published.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent source A and redirect destination B with distinct app commits.
behaviors.expected: Explicit opt-out preserves the source URL and installs A after metadata refresh advertises B.

behaviors.description: Re-enable summary redirection after explicitly pinning a remote URL.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A source and B redirect destination; explicit URL initially prevents following.
behaviors.expected: Follow-redirect changes the public remote URL to B and installs the exact independent B app commit.

mappings.rationale: Public subset persistence, rejection without fallback and successful clear distinguish the setting.

surface_assertions.rationale: An absent subset blocks otherwise installable refs until explicitly cleared.

mappings.rationale: Exact distinct collection properties and final verified deployment establish the selected remote identity.

surface_assertions.rationale: Explicit changes persist the exact independent collection identity.

mappings.rationale: Independent summary metadata changes distinguish refresh from a cached no-op.

surface_assertions.rationale: Explicit refresh changes both public metadata fields from independent A to B values.

mappings.rationale: The configured URL and installed independent commit distinguish redirect refusal from following.

surface_assertions.rationale: Persisted opt-out retains the source URL and A payload despite a newly published B redirect.

mappings.rationale: A pinned-URL control is followed by an explicit opt-in with a different public URL and independent commit.

surface_assertions.rationale: Opt-in enables redirection that an explicitly pinned URL had prevented.
